The Workshop

Eight years of
slow work

The workshop started in 2016 with a single walnut slab and a set of hand planes. Eight years later, we still make every piece ourselves — no production line, no shortcuts.

We source lumber from regional mills and sustainably harvested private timberlands in the Pacific Northwest. When you buy from Hollow & Grain, you're getting something made slowly, on purpose.
